stories.title: Psychedelic mushrooms to be considered as low-priority by law enforcement in Nevada City
stories.summary: Nevada City is looking into developing a low-priority law enforcement policy in regards to the personal planting, cultivation, possession, and transportation of naturally occurring entheogenic plants and fungi by adults 21 years of age and older.

stories.title: Nevada County fined $31,500 for Measure V political spending violations
stories.summary: Nevada County was taken to task last week by California’s Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC) for what the commission calls violations which occurred in 2022 surrounding the failed Measure V 1/2 cent sales tax ballot proposal.

stories.summary: Few things, culinarily speaking, are as sad as scraping your tortilla chip against the bottom of a (now) empty bowl of guacamole. In fact, some may consider this "guac bottom." So, how did we end up here?

stories.title: At least 17 killed as flash flood sweeps part of Nepal-Tibet border
stories.summary: The flood in Rasuwa - an area north of Kathmandu bordering Tibet - is feared to have swept away villages.
